input: Build a wooden raised bed for herbs

gold.taskTitle: Build a wooden raised bed for herbs
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to construct a wooden raised garden bed specifically for growing herbs.

questions.title: What dimensions do you want the raised bed to be?
questions.description: Clarify the intended length, width, and height of the raised bed.

questions.title: Where exactly will the raised bed be placed?
questions.description: Determine the location, such as a backyard, patio, balcony, or indoors.

questions.title: Which specific herbs are you planning to grow?
questions.description: Identify the herbs to ensure the bed depth and soil mix are appropriate.

questions.title: What type of wood do you want to use?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preference for cedar, pine, redwood, or another wood type.

questions.title: Do you already have tools and materials at home?
questions.description: Assess what the user already owns versus what needs to be purchased.

questions.title: What is your budget for this project?
questions.description: Understand the financial constraints to recommend appropriate materials and sourcing.

questions.title: What is your experience level with woodworking?
questions.description: Gauge the user's skill level to tailor the complexity of the build plan and instructions.
